calls.video_title: This Pullback is a Gift. I'm Buying These 3 Stocks NOW.
calls.price_at_call: ~$5.5B mkt cap; EPS $2.46 this yr (P/E ~21), $3.39 next yr (P/E ~15, 14 analysts); P/S below 1 (stated)
calls.thesis: Direct play on modernising US air-traffic control after the FAA groundings: just won a ~$600M FAA contract extension for air-traffic facilities, comms, radar, navigation and power; DoT has asked for ~$50B more, and Parsons is positioned for a slice.
calls.base_case: Headline-driven but cheap on sales and earnings; EPS rebounds next year as contracts land.
calls.bull_case: Bipartisan pressure to fund ATC modernisation turns into multi-billion-dollar awards; a $5.5B company moves a lot on hundred-million contracts.
calls.bear_case: Event-driven volatility: contracts roll off (EPS -22% YoY this year) and gaps between awards hurt; funding depends on politics.
